messages:
samir: Heads-up: CVE review completed for NV driver 535. Prioritizing patches across CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 9.0, NCCL 2.18. Need consensus on test matrix and rollout windows.

maria: Thanks. What's the risk delta? Any exploit PoC?

samir: No public PoC. CVE shows local privilege escalation in driver ioctls. Impact high for shared hosts (Dedicated pools). Priority: high for Dedicated, medium for Hosted with RBAC mitigation.

jordan: Suggest criteria: exploitability, deployment exposure (shared vs private), rollback surface, compat risk. Can we get perf regression tests? :chart_with_downwards_trend: 

lee: On compat - CUDA 12.1 -> driver 535 verified on our 5 GPU SKUs. cuDNN 9.0 has an ABI change for convs (stride handling). Need model-level smoke tests: resnet50 FP16, llm kv-cache loop. Put tests in eng-ml infra.

samir: Proposed schedule: patch driver 535 on canaries Mon 03:00 UTC -> verify smoke tests 12h -> expand to Dedicated pools over 48h. Hosteds get rolling restart with KMS-signed driver artifacts.

maria: KMS question: do we sign driver packages with customer KMS or our central KMS? Security wants package signing with HSM-stored key. Ops: does installer support signatures verification? @ops-bot can you confirm?

ops-bot: installer v2.7 supports pkg signature verification against a public key. HSM integration is planned for next sprint. Current suggestion: sign builds with our production KMS and store audit logs in S3 bucket with restricted RBAC.

jordan: RBAC note: restrict "driver-deploy" permission to infra-admins; require 2FA + ticket in Jira for emergency exceptions. Audit logging must record SHA256 and KMS key ID.

lee: Test commands for quick smoke:
```
modinfo nvidia | grep -i version
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available()); print(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).name)"
# LLM KV smoke
python tests/kv_smoke.py --model loralite --tokens 512
```

samir: Can someone own verification matrix? @lee please own kernel/driver tests. @jordan own RBAC/audit. @maria own KMS signing convo with security. I'll draft rollout playbook.

maria: Ack. I'll sync with security and post a short checklist.

jordan: Adding 2 commands to CI for gating: run_resnet_smoke, run_kv_smoke. Fail build if either regression > 5% accuracy/perf.

samir: Great. Action items: create Jira epic INFRA-DRIVER-2026, schedule canary Mon 03:00 UTC, update runbook, sign artifacts with prod KMS. Last call for objections.

lee: No objections. I'll start test harness and upload matrix by EOD.

ops-bot: Deployment job scheduled for 1894650000 (Mon 03:00 UTC) in staging canary.

samir: last_message: Thanks all, will post final playbook here when ready. :pray:
